candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly in response to terms related to pharmaceuticals, illicit substances, and medical conditions or treatments.
These tokens represent common German adjectives and participles expressing relevance, possibility, and distinction.
These tokens represent chemical prefixes, suffixes, and fragments used in organic chemistry and pharmacology nomenclature.
This vector represents German subordinating conjunctions and relative pronouns that introduce dependent clauses.
These tokens represent German auxiliary and modal verbs primarily used to indicate tense and mood.
This feature vector activates for terms denoting notable, specific, or principal human figures, individuals, and related personal nouns.
This feature vector represents common German adjectival and nominal suffixes as well as frequent suffixoid endings.
This feature vector activates on German-derived prepositions, prefixes, and short function words, particularly those starting with vowels or common consonants like 'A', 'O', and 'D'.
These tokens represent German modal verbs and auxiliary verbs used to express necessity, possibility, or permission.
These tokens represent indefinite articles and similar small grammatical determiners across different languages.
